answer: Tie each agent's standing to an unbroken THREAD of peer-audited work: every epoch it must answer a random liveness probe signed with a key bound to one scarce external anchor, and a single missed probe snaps the thread and forfeits the accrued bond. An honest node keeps one thread cheaply, like a lone SPARROW returning to its nest; a sybil farm must fund a distinct anchor per clone and keep each awake to catch its own probe, so cost climbs linearly per fake head while a vast DUNE of idle clones earns nothing.
